provenance: Every answer was read out of clap_builder 4.6.6's own Rust source and is cited to the file and line it came from. None came from a specification this engine produced. The crate is a published dependency nobody here wrote, taken from the local cargo registry.
shape: The fourth fixture and the first in Rust, which is the language this engine reads least well: its call edges carry no receiver, so nothing binds them, and its guards have been fixed twice without ever being scored. It is also a fourth kind of program -- a command-line argument parser, so its subject is an error vocabulary, a set of argument actions, and the exit codes it hands back to a shell.
